aiActionsAddToThe: AI actions add to the board, so they need edit access.
theCatchUpCouldnT: The catch-up couldn’t be made. Try again.
thatItemIsnTOn: That item isn’t on the board any more.
catchUpAddedToThe: Catch-up added to the board. Undo takes it back.
onlyYouSeeThisInsert: Only you see this. Insert on board adds it as a note everyone sees (one step you can undo). AI can be wrong: check what it cites.
aShortWrittenSummaryOf: A short written summary of what other people added, changed, removed and commented on, with links to the items. Only you see it.
whatChangedAsYouCan: What changed (as you can see it) is sent to {provider}, set up by
newChildrenForAMind: New children for a mind-map topic.
aSummaryOfWhatOthers: A summary of what others changed, just for you.
aNoteBesideTheActivity: A note beside the activity with themes, notable answers and suggested next steps, from the results everyone can see.
stickyNotesAboutYourPrompt: Sticky notes about your prompt, with the {value} as background.
stickyNotesAboutYourPrompt2: Sticky notes about your prompt, next to what you’re looking at.
selectTwoOrMoreNotes: Select two or more notes to sort them into groups.
sortsTheValueIntoPositive: Sorts the {value} into positive, neutral, mixed and negative.
aWrittenSummaryOfThe: A written summary of the meeting, added inside its frame.
aWrittenSummaryOfThe2: A written summary of the {value}, placed beside them.
aWrittenSummaryOfThe3: A written summary of the whole board.
aDiagramBuiltFromThe: A diagram built from the {value} (and your prompt).
aDiagramOfWhatYou: A diagram of what you describe.
optionalWhatToFocusOn: Optional: what to focus on, e.g. what to do next quarter
optionalHowToGroupThem: Optional: how to group them, e.g. by customer pain
optionalWhatToFocusOn3: Optional: what to focus on, e.g. decisions and owners
someOfTheseNotesAre: Some of these notes are other people’s, so the AI’s sorting was added as suggestions to accept or reject.
theAiRequestFailedTry: The AI request failed. Try again.
addedByAiUndoTakes: Added by AI. Undo takes it back.
nothingIsOnTheBoard: Nothing is on the board yet. Insert adds it as one step you can undo. AI can be wrong: check it before you rely on it.
yourPromptAndTheActivity: Your prompt and the activity’s results (never who answered) are
yourPromptAndTheBoard: Your prompt and the board content it reads are
countSelectedItem: {count, plural, one {# selected item} other {# selected items}}
countSelectedNote: {count, plural, one {# selected note} other {# selected notes}}
theAssistantCouldnTAnswer: The assistant couldn’t answer. Try again.
proposedCountChanges: Proposed {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} as suggestions
noLongerPendingAccepted: Decided: nothing is waiting here any more.
addThreeStickiesWithNext: Add three stickies with next steps
theAssistantProposedChanges: The assistant proposed changes. Nothing changes until they’re accepted.
askAboutWhatSOn: Ask about what’s on this board, or ask for changes: it reads the board as you see it and cites the items it uses. Changes come as suggestions you accept or reject.
askAboutWhatSOnRead: Ask about what’s on this board: it reads the board as you see it and cites the items it uses.
theBoardAsYouSee: Your questions and the board as you see it go to {provider}. Board text is read as data, never as instructions. Only you see this conversation.
itOnlyProposesChanges: It never changes the board itself.
yourQuestionsAndItsAnswers: Your questions and its answers on this board are deleted. Suggestions it already proposed stay on the board.
